channel.title: Favourite GoI?
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Favourite GoI?" - The Foundation in-verse got theirselves some pretty interesting groups don't they? Let's talk about them!

item.title: Re: Favourite GoI?
item.content:encoded: The sheer neutral evil of the Factory is delightful. I also appreciate their/its simplicity and mystery compared to the more detailed evil GoIs like Sarkics and the CotBG.

item.title: Re: Favourite GoI?
item.content:encoded:
I'd have to go with The Factory as far as villains go- pure banal evil incarnate. Serpent's hand and Herman Fuller tie as a close second, for the opposite reason- 90% redeemable, 10% amoral backstabbing.

Prometheus Labs is probably my favorite neutral party- I'm a sucker for their marriage of mad science and design by committee.

item.title: Re: Favourite GoI?
item.content:encoded: I found the Mages Academy a really interesting GoI sadly there's isn't much still about it and the DE isn't as fleshed as I would love to.

item.title: Re: Favourite GoI?
item.content:encoded: CotBG and Sarkic Cults are just super interesting to me, probably third is GOC, or Are We Cool Yet? I’m into art, not like an artist but picking it apart and shit like that, so this whole anart thing tickles my fancy.

item.title: Re: Favourite GoI?
item.content:encoded: I think my personal favorite is Parawatch. I just love the old creepypasta format, there is honestly some really well written stuff on there. in my opinion it deserves more love.

item.title: Re: Favourite GoI?
item.content:encoded:
I side with the GOC philosophically

Way to get political, dude.

(This post is satirical in nature.)

item.title: Re: Favourite GoI?
item.content:encoded: I side with the GOC philosophically, so they're my favorite GoI currently. Church of the Broken God is pretty cool too.

item.title: Re: Favourite GoI?
item.content:encoded: They are a minor Goi but will likely never become a fully fledged one because they are technical just part of the GOC

item.title: Re: Favourite GoI?
item.content:encoded: GOC get waaaaaayyy too much shit. They are an incredibly interesting GoI in my opinion with the whole council of 108 anomalous organizations. I am 100% a simp for D.C al Fine and I love the stuff that Clef did with them in the GOC Casefiles Canon

item.title: Re: Favourite GoI?
item.content:encoded: Deer College because I love reading their news format and interactions in Void. I have fun reading college student shenanigans with anomalies into it. It's weird that there's no ICSUT GOI yet and it's not easy to find stuff about ICSUT.

item.title: Re: Favourite GoI?
item.content:encoded: I like pattern screamers because they hit exactly on the line of knowing enough about what it is to be creeped the heck out but not knowing so much that it becomes comprehensible and loses its punch. They're alien, they're inexplicable, they're awesome.

item.title: Re: Favourite GoI?
item.content:encoded:
The SPC.

When a skip cause the Foundation to soil themselves but they're more concern about it isn't punched yet, you know they're true badass.

item.title: Re: Favourite GoI?
item.content:encoded:
I'm still rummaging around in the different GOIs, but I do love the underdogs, so I have a personal enjoyment from the Unusual Incidents Unit, though Wondertainment also has its charm, since I really like SCPs that are simply inexplicable, or strange even if they aren't huge in scope or particularly important.

Also, I think Wondertainment might have been the first GOI I encountered perusing the site.

item.title: Re: Favourite GoI?
item.content:encoded:
Nobody was always one of my favourites, and I never thought he (/She/They/It/Them/Those/That) got the love he deserves. Though maybe it's just my personal love of vagabond characters that got me hooked.

I've really enjoyed the new "Man in the White Suit" series to come out of "The Man Who Wasn't There", so now I'm just sitting here praying it kickstarts the cannon again.

item.title: Re: Favourite GoI?
item.content:encoded:
For me it’s the Gamers Against Weed. Why? Well..:
1.I am a gamer.
2. I don’t like weed.
3. I love discord
gamers against weed 4 life dude :)

item.title: Re: Favourite GoI?
item.content:encoded: I'm a fan of the Global Occult Coalition. I just think the concept of the UN doing the work of the Foundation (Although much more aggressive) is interesting. Probably because its something I can fathom. Also the UN has always been major to me. Their mission and its history. And i'm quite fond of the current GOC files. Very well written.

item.title: Favourite GoI?
item.content:encoded:
The title is a bit self explanatory indeed

My case? I believe in The Serpent's Hand supremacy, I just love their vibe overall and how open to interpretation and writings they can be, from people who just want the anomalous and the normal to coexist peacefully to lunatics that can go fucking ham, and who doesn't love a magic library where almost everything is posible?

A posible second favourite might be the Sarkic cults, I love me some good fleshy eldritch abominations
